cohort: 48,867 primiparous women from mainland China who had a full-term singleton birth
finding: Excessive gestational weight gain was associated with increased risks of gestational hypertension, postpartum hemorrhage, cesarean section, and delivery of large-for-gestational-age infants, while inadequate weight gain was associated with increased risks of gestational diabetes and small-for-gestational-age infants.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in women with excessive GWG compared to women with normal weight gain.
